missions.name: Sounding Rocket
missions.brief: Reach 100 km altitude and return the payload intact. This is the first mission every space program flies.

missions.name: Low Earth Orbit
missions.tagline: The hardest part is staying up
missions.brief: Reach orbital velocity and place a payload in a stable 200 km orbit. This is what every satellite needs.

missions.name: Lunar Flyby
missions.tagline: Escape the well, fall toward the Moon
missions.brief: Push past Earth escape velocity, coast to the Moon, and return. Three days out, three days back.

missions.name: Mars Orbiter
missions.tagline: Seven months alone in the dark
missions.brief: Launch during a real window, coast 259 days, and enter Mars orbit with enough fuel left to correct your aim.

missions.name: Mars Sample Return
missions.tagline: Bring a piece of another world home
missions.brief: Everything in one mission: launch, transfer, orbit, land, drill, ascend, and return. Two separate flights worth of hardware in one stack.
